status: Audit complete; Agentic 5K and AgentGuard processed and used for local MLP injection training.

agentic5k.use: Auxiliary injection-detection training, then banking-specific fine-tuning.
limitations: Labels identify injection presence, not observed tool-call correctness or successful compromise.
Templated synthetic text; row count does not equal independent real-world incidents.

agentguard.use: Supplemental inter-agent injection detection; create grouped train/validation/test sets.
limitations: No official train/validation/test split is provided in the downloaded repository.
Benign and adversarial files have different schemas: normalize fields and never feed label/reasoning/category columns as inputs.
No observed banking result or agent-error attribution.

toolfault.use: Separate diagnostic evaluation with a fault-label adapter; keep the official test set held out.
limitations: The author explicitly intends this small benchmark for evaluation, not training.
Thirteen classes include none; the other twelve are fault categories.
Timeouts, rate limits, and ordinary server failures do not imply an adversary or an agent-planning error.
Gold recovery, rationale, fault_type and meta must not be features.

aftraj.use: Optional auxiliary online-failure localization with prefix extraction and task-level grouping.
input_fields: turns up to the current decision point
limitations: safe and unsafe are label partitions, not training and test splits.
unsafe_source=injected means a controlled decisive-error intervention; it is not a malicious-adversary label.
Do not label every turn in an unsafe trajectory as incorrect or include future turns or gold annotations in the input.
Long traces require a deliberate prefix/window policy for Laya rather than silent truncation.
The named responsible agent is not the same label as our agent-versus-adversary cause.

holdout_audit.action: If training on the remainder, exclude or regroup tasks matching the held-out tasks; keep safe/unsafe variants together.

integration_required: No dataset can be dropped unchanged into the current three-cause banking trainer. Add explicit task adapters/auxiliary targets; do not invent missing banking labels.
suggested_sequence: Add injection-detection adapters for Agentic 5K and AgentGuard.
Train both model families on the auxiliary task using controlled splits.
Fine-tune the banking correctness/cause task on additional simulator data.
Evaluate on untouched banking test episodes and separately adapted ToolFault diagnostics.
audit_limits: Exact and normalized duplicate checks do not establish absence of near-duplicate templates.
Dataset cards and sampled record semantics were inspected; external labels were not independently re-annotated.

implementation_status.laya: handled by teammate; shared typed data can be reused
